findings.subject: C1
findings.candidate: Global NOT_SUPPORTED unreachable under unchanged current v2 rules
basis: ADAS templates have exactly one root in both sizes
First paired H/L arrival precedes all later slots
Positive-duration H root dispatch leaves unique one-ready in-scope view
View enters E but not F and cannot be deduplicated away
Every valid ADAS seed/condition therefore has coverage<1
All12 negative rule requires coverage=1 in every seed/condition
limitations: Conditional on valid complete execution under unchanged v2 definitions
No claim about actual opportunity rate or support reachability
exculpatory_definitions_reviewed: Invalid input closes criterion rather than creates counterexample
findings.recommendation: Document explicit human resolution before approval; do not silently alter scope or coverage cutoff

findings.subject: C2
remaining_gap: Common exclusion domain across authorization/attempt identities
Lease receipt exact fields and stale-owner fencing
Atomic budget reservation versus duplicate calls
findings.refuted_overstatement: The design does not completely omit locking or recovery; no actual race was executed or proven
findings.recommendation: Specify exclusion/ownership/fencing contract and future runtime tests before implementation claims

findings.subject: C3
findings.candidate: Actual execution Git HEAD and observed dirty status not required by typed records
already_specified: Runner prose promises separately recorded actual execution HEAD
remaining_gap: No required actual execution HEAD/status field or typed artifact membership
Capture point and independent verification missing
findings.refuted_overstatement: Generic raw_artifacts could represent additional provenance; representation is possible but not bound or required
findings.recommendation: Bind actual execution provenance receipt or fields explicitly without confusing source commit and runtime checkout

findings.subject: C4
findings.candidate: M2 paired completeness not bound to JSON criterion and stage evidence
already_specified: Decision table requires M2 paired completeness
Main proposal and SP27 define M2
Same-input method trial data are planned
remaining_gap: Explicit M2 completeness predicate absent from JSON preconditions
No required M2 report schema/pair membership/verification receipt in stage contract
findings.refuted_overstatement: Generic diagnostic_report_ref/prerequisite_evidence can carry M2; requirement is present in prose, not absent from entire design
findings.recommendation: Make M2 pairing evidence membership and rejection behavior explicit before claiming a machine-complete gate
